items.title: 'elsewhere.' - 'The world can wait.' over a ringed peach planet
items.description: A dark starfield hero for 'elsewhere.': 'A SMALL ESCAPE FROM EVERYTHING', 'The world can wait.' in serif/italic, a big peach marbled planet with a thin ring, '02 / EMBERLIGHT - You don't have to be anywhere else.' A calm escape landing.

items.title: Promise Wall - 'Make a promise' modal with paper swatches
items.description: A 'Make a promise' modal over a sticky-note wall: 'Write it as if your future self will read it here.', promise 'Learn new things using AI everyday', category chips (Health... Self-Growth...), paper swatches, tags #growth #discipline #future and 'Place it on the wall'. A commitment-board composer.

items.title: Crema - 'Your coffee, fast.' hero with a phone on a pedestal
items.description: A 'Crema' product page in a Morbility clone frame: 'Your coffee, fast.' serif headline, copy on ordering ahead, App Store / Google Play buttons, and a black phone staged on a cream pedestal with a plant. A coffee-app commerce hero.

items.title: Realtime education - evolution lesson with jungle art and audio
items.description: A 'Max Realtime Education' session: a jungle illustration with a chimpanzee on a branch beside evolution text ('Evolution is descent with modification...'), with a listening waveform bar and 'Connected' status. A live reading/teaching session, not a designer portfolio.

items.title: MEOW AI AGENT - scanline cat landing with Get Started
items.description: A monochrome landing: pixel-block 'MEOW AI AGENT' headline, 'Your personal AI assistant, helping you manage tasks and make smarter decisions.', Get Started / See How It Works, and a scanline-drawn cat. A playful agent landing.

items.title: Money app feature strip - six white cards with red glyphs
items.description: Six feature cards: 'Track your money at a glance', 'Send money in seconds', 'Stay on top of spending', 'Never miss a due date', 'Get more for every payment', 'Your money, protected', each with a small red-accented diagram. A banking feature grid.

items.title: Bookcrumbs - One Minute Manager quote on a cream card
items.description: A blue-framed cream page from 'Bookcrumbs': 'Making mistakes is not the problem. It's not learning from them that causes real problems.' attributed to The One Minute Manager (Ken Blanchard & Spencer Johnson), with 'Enjoying the notes? You could buy me a coffee'. A quote-note page.

items.title: Outgaze Studio - integrations page with connected tools
items.description: A localhost 'Outgaze Studio' app: Integrations panel (Claude Connect, GitHub/Slack/Figma Connected, GPT, Vercel, ClickUp, Notion, Chromatic, Storybook, Maze) over a blue activity canvas ('Updated 23 tasks...', 'Reviewed 14 pull requests...'), sidebar of agents. Same product as VID-0227.

items.title: Outgaze Studio chat - Monday-numbers agent with task list
items.description: A 'Gurgiew Studio' chat: 'Turn the Monday numbers post into an agent: Metabase to Slack, filed in Notion.' with a Read-tasks checklist and 'Thinking...' status; the sidebar lists the same agents as VID-0328. An agent conversation, not a text-heavy page.

items.title: Inori profile - CS student with m3e-canvas featured project
items.description: A profile page: 'Inori @Inkiai - CS student / AI engineer' with anime avatar and navy Contact button, FEATURED card 'm3e-canvas - Sketch Material 3 Expressive screens in the browser, then turn them into prompts for AI coding tools.' (Trending #1). A developer profile.

items.title: Harshit Beniwal - chat-style product designer portfolio
items.description: A portfolio as a chat: 'sup?' / 'not much, just vibing and pretending my inbox doesn't exist', Harshit Beniwal (San Francisco), 'Hello, I am a # Product Designer who...', Work/Play/Notes/Others chips and a 'tell me' composer. A conversational portfolio, not Harold Bernard.

items.title: rivet - red dot-matrix wordmark landing with install CTA
items.description: A cream landing for 'rivet': giant red dot-matrix wordmark, Docs / Release notes and a red 'Install Rivet' pill top-right, footer columns (Releases, MCP, Contact / Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram), © 2026 Rivet, Inc. A dev-tool landing.

items.title: Cream canvas explainer - flowchart cards with a presenter bubble
items.description: A cream app canvas showing connected flowchart cards and a 'What do you want to understand?' input, with a presenter webcam bubble bottom-right. A live demo/explainer frame.
